verdict.rationale: There is no export command, but skills are stored as plain local files. SKILL.md is YAML frontmatter plus Markdown, and skills install into project or user directories that can be committed to the repo. Skills come from user-owned GitHub, GitLab, Azure or URL sources and work across any skills-compatible agent, and `skills remove` plus a skills-lock.json restore make leaving or moving straightforward. Missing for 10: an explicit export command or documented data-portability guarantee, any statement on exporting account or telemetry data held by skills.sh, and independent hands-on corroboration of migrating away.
